title: A flaw was found in CRI-O. An attacker with access to the kubelet or CRI-O socket can exploit a path traversal…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in CRI-O's checkpoint restore functionality that allows an attacker with access to the kubelet or CRI-O socket to delete arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem. This occurs because checkpoint archive metadata entries are processed without ensuring files remain confined to the container's root directory. Exploitation requires elevated privileges and enabling non-default checkpoint/restore features, which are disabled by default in typical OpenShift deployments, reducing exposure. The vulnerability impacts system availability and integrity by permitting deletion of critical host files.
